reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience with Dr. Nettune at Blink today! Our 11-year-old Chihuahua mix has been struggling with a corneal ulcer for over three weeks without any improvement. Thanks to a last-minute cancellation, we were fortunate enough to get an appointment the very same day.
From  the moment we walked through the door, we felt comfortable and welcomed. The check-in process was smooth and easy, and every member of the team was incredibly friendly and welcoming, despite the office being very busy.
Dr. Nettune took his time thoroughly examining our little boy and determined that he has a bacterial infection in his eye. He patiently explained his findings and treatment plan, making sure we understood everything without ever making us feel rushed.
The total cost of our visit was $540, including the consultation, medications, and a protective collar. While this was certainly a significant expense, the consultation itself was $200, and we understand that the necessary medications and equipment are part of the treatment. After five previous veterinary visits without improvement, we are incredibly grateful to finally have a diagnosis and a clear treatment plan. Having answers and knowing that our boy is now receiving the care he needs means so much to us.
From the front office staff to the technicians and, of course, Dr. Nettune himself, everyone made us feel that our boy was in caring and capable hands.
We are incredibly grateful for the kindness, professionalism, and excellent care we received. We would wholeheartedly recommend Blink to anyone looking for outstanding eye care for their beloved pets!

Excellent care by Dr. Chris and his clinical (and admin) staff.  We had an emergency with our dog's eye and they worked us in immediately.  A surgical procedure was necessary and he was able to do it later on the SAME day.  This lowered the stress level for our family immeasurably.  We had to ask a question on the weekend and Dr. Chris and his clinical staff responded within 30 minutes.  Again, this lowered our stress level immeasurably.
Dr. Chris excels in communicating the clinical/technical aspects of the situation and why the recommended treatment plan will address the problem.  You will not find a more experienced and well rounded canine ophthalmologist in Dallas or Collin County.  We feel very fortunate to have him as Lola's eye doctor!

Dr. ENG and the tech were terrific with my old man Zeke. a Boston Terrier. They examined him staining his eyes and checking his eye pressure. They took him back and did a burr procedure and put a contact lens in his left eye to protect it and a cone. We received eye drops and pain meds and will see them back in 2 weeks.

If you are looking for the best eye specialist for your dog i would highly recommend
Dr Nettune at Blink veterinary eye specialists He is  excellent ! His staff is caring and friendly.

Highly recommend! The Ophthalmologist, Dr Nettune and his staff were amazing. I recently took my 10 yo Border Collie in to have his two eyelid masses removed. The moment I walked into the office I was greeted by the friendliest client services representative, Jeanette. She got us into a room quickly where we did not have to wait long before our tech Shyquinca arrived. She was kind and patient with my kiddo while taking the initial history and diagnostics. My dog can be very picky about strangers, but he absolutely loved her and Dr Nettune right away. During the appointment the doctor was excellent at explaining the procedure and giving prognosis. When our tech came back in to get my pup it was hard to leave him behind, but I was confident he was in good hands. He was done exactly when they predicted, and when I arrived to pick him up he they brought him out to me right away. I could tell his technician genuinely liked him and she was so caring and detail oriented through our discharge.
We are now a few months after the procedure and his eyelids look like the mass never existed to begin with. I am so impressed with the team at Blink and Dr Nettune. As a Veterinarian myself, I am now recommending them to anyone who needs an ophthalmologist.

The Blink team and Dr. Nettune have been wonderful. They are always so kind and genuine. Whenever I had questions and reached out, they were always willing to help and provided great information. They are communicative and responsive, and they took such good care of our dog. Every visit was a pleasant experience. We are so grateful to everyone who helped our dog regain his vision and joy from his cataracts.

Dr. Nettune and the team are top notch, my kitty had a terrible ulcer and another issue with her eye and Dr. was great at giving me the facts and how to heal her eye without the need of surgery.  We are so grateful we were referred to Blink and kitty was all healed up!

Dr Nettune and staff are wonderful, genuinely caring, professional and so good at at putting all of us at ease.  All procedures and treatments explained very well.  I highly recommend this practice.  We wouldn't go anywhere else for eye care for our dogs.

This vet practice for ophthalmology has been amazing for my dog.  I really believe they are saving his eye.  They are caring, responsive, very professional, very accommodating when your pet needs help. The staff could not be more welcoming.
Excellent!!!!!!!!! Saved my Harlow from another surgery. I'm grateful for Blink!

Dr. Nettune and his staff are fantastic!! I arrived thirty minutes early to my appointment and they were still able to see me and my baby right away. They were on point the entire time, and it genuinely took two minutes to get the diagnosis that we have been trying to get for four years. Everyone was so kind and knowledgeable and I am so glad my vet recommended Blink.

My Rescue group and I had an amazing experience with Blink As well as amazing results. Sorren, Formally known as Rowan was seen with a priority severe Cherry eye. She was extremely inflamed, and this is a breed Known to have issues with this type of surgery. We’re almost a year postop, and I love seeing her eyes.

My dog had a growth on his eyelid that was causing severe irritation, and his vet referred him to Blink. They were able to get him in very quickly due to a last-minute cancellation. The office staff is friendly and efficient and intake was a breeze. Dr. Nettune came back quickly and conducted a thorough examination of my 12 year old schnauzer. He outlined the pros and cons of two recommended treatment plans in detail. The process didn’t feel rushed at all and he patiently answered any questions I had. He even took some time with my younger pup who accompanied us and gave some advice for his eye health. I can tell Dr. Nettune is a true animal lover by the way my schnauzers reacted to him - they’re not always easy to win over lol. Blink was able to schedule the procedure that very same day at what I thought was a reasonable price.

My Digit is doing wonderfully and is already back to his old self. Thank you Blink Veterinary Eye Specialists - you all are wonderful!
Great doctors and team in general.

I want to thank Blink team members for helping Polo in a time of distress for our family. When we found out that Polo had cataracts on both of his eyes, our primary vet recommended us to Blink, and honestly, my family and I couldn’t have been happier. Within less than a week Polo was getting his eye exams and surgery, and we thank God that he can see again. Dr. Nettune and his team are truly amazing, from having a one-to-one consultations with Dr. Nettune, which he explains in great details the issues going on in your dogs eyes, to making sure we understand. The Blink truly amazing as well super friendly, caring, kind, and helpful throughout the process. They would send updates about polo when he was going to surgery, when he got out, and pictures of him in the front office with them. My family and I are so happy and at peace knowing that Polo was in good hands. Blink is truly and amazing place!

Could not be happier with Dr. Nettune, Jeanette, et al. I took my Big Dog Caesar in for an eye that was tearing uncontrollably on the recommendation of my veterinarian. I was seen promptly, and told to be prepared for surgery the day I came in if that was required. The least invasive option was tried first, and it worked perfectly! The follow up and response from Dr. Nettune and his team was first rate. Unqualified recommendation for this fine clinic!
True miracle workers, saved our dog’s life, we had traveled all over the country trying to find a solution to our dog’s eye problem and Blink was the only ones that could help!

Five stars are not enough! The level of care, compassion, and helping make sure we understood everything is unmatched! Thank you so much for seeing our sweet Sadie so quickly and helping us get her on the path to healing!

Wonderful veterinary ophthalmology practice with kind people. My Corgi hit her left lateral eye on a metal stool in the dog park behind our building, and while we ruled out all the scary diagnoses at the ER that night, I wanted some reassurance. Blink was able to squeeze me in the very next day. Dr. Nettune is very knowledgeable, changed the ointment we’d been prescribed and by the next day, her eye was looking a lot better. The nice thing too about the practice is they encourage you to text if you have any questions, which they monitor closely. Would highly recommend Blink if you have any problems or questions about the eyes of your dogs/pets.

Everything is first rate at Blink. The staff is extremely kind and caring.  Dr. Nettune exceeded our expectations in every way.  He offered three procedural options for the removal of a cyst on our dog’s eyelid.  We chose the minimally invasive option the doctor said he would choose for his own dog.  Everything went perfectly.  Our post-op visit today confirmed that everything went exactly as hoped.  We definitely recommend Dr. Nettune and his team.

I am a veterinarian, and have been taking my personal pet to Dr. Nettune for cataract care. Finally decided it was time for cataract removal surgery. He took amazing care of Coco. My 15-year old dog's quality of life has improved significantly. I couldn't be happier! Dr. Nettune and his staff are the best!
What kind of specialist doesn't know what's going on with my cat's eye... that's literally what you trained for.  Sent me home with some antibiotics that did nothing.  Thanks for nothing.
Dr. Nettune is the absolute best!

How can I explain  the perfect .    The dr saved my king HAYATE eye few years ago only with one visit.     Today March 26 we visit this office again .  Perfect again. Staff , his assistant .   The best dr in town .  Thank you for everything .

Cannot recommend Dr. Nettune and his staff.  They've been kind, compassionate, and unbelievably dedicated to our sweet Tucker.  Patient comfort and health are non-negotiable with them.  We cannot recommend them enough to anyone needing help with their pet.
They are the best. Very imformative, taken great care Dallas and hisbeye issue.
Fantastic experience all around and Dr. Nettune and team took excellent care of our dog!

My experience here has been Fantastic. The front staff is so nice and gentle with my fur baby and took great care of her. The doctor diagnosed the issue right away and cleared it up! Would 1000% recommend!

I cant not rave about or recommend this practice enough.  Dr. Nettune's level of care and detail are truly unmatched.  His bed side manner is amazing, he is caring and always ensures calm interactions with the animals.  He talks to them and does what he can to reassure them they are safe.  I especially love how well he explains what is needed and what is to be expected to the Pet Parents.  One thing that truly ment the most to me and my family was Dr. Nettune gave us a number and if there was ever a question or concern we could reach out via text and send pictures.  We would get quick responses that either reassured us that everything was good or if our fur baby needed to be brought in.  The staff Dr. Nettune has on his team is professional, kind, helpful, and just as attentive.   The office and rooms are very clean and you can truly see how they care and love animals.   To say it was worth the 100 mile round trip is an understatement.  I recommend Dr. Nettune and his practice to anyone in need of their services and assure them this it is worth every mile and penny.

I had an amazing experience at Blink while navigating a really scary time. From the moment we walked in, the front desk staff were incredibly kind and comforting. Dr. Nettune was wonderful with my dog, who is normally very nervous around men. He was gentle, patient, and made both of us feel at ease. They’ve been so helpful guiding me through next steps and coordinating with other specialists. I truly feel supported every step of the way. I highly recommend this clinic!

Our little hero developed glaucoma and was having a very rough time. Blink took excellent care of him, explained everything succinctly, and made the whole ordeal a little less traumatic. Fitzgerald is doing great now. Highly recommend.
The doctor was able to help us with the kitten that had a black eye. The experience was perfect.

I work with a rescue and took in a blind kitten. The staff was friendly & helpful. Dr. Nettune examined her, was thorough & patient. He explained her situation well & took his time to answer questions A++

Dr. Nettune and his staff made us feeel comfortable from the beginning. Our vet hoghly recommended Blink and I understand why they did. We felt welcome and like the best interest of our doggie was first and foremost from the beginning. I would strongly recommend Blink.
One of the best experiences and care we have received. They are very knowledgeable and extremely caring. We’re repeat visitors and would recommend to anyone. They are great.
All the staff is super helpful and Dr. NETTUNE is very thorough, appreciate him.
Doc is amazing

Dr. Nettune and his staff were absolutely phenomenal! I couldn’t have asked for better service! They provided such passionate care and took the time to explain what was wrong with my dog and the treatment plan! They answered my questions late at night when I was concerned his eye was getting worse and gave me much needed reassurance! I couldn’t recommend them more! So thankful for the care they provided!

They truly saved my dog’s eye! She had a painful ulcer from a scratch that became infected, and our regular vet referred us to Blink. I’m so grateful they did. The team at Blink quickly diagnosed the issue, started her on the right eye drops, and her eye improved almost immediately. Thanks to them, she’s recovering so well. Blink is pricey, but the level of care is worth it. I can’t thank them enough!

The team and staff is wonderful and does a great job! I am a little disappointed after a follow up appointment ended up being a very short consult just to refill the same prescription and still being $250. The first appointment was also very short, around 15 minutes, and the same price. I understand the initial appointment being that cost, but for a quick look at her eyes again (less than 5 minutes) to be charged the same price seemed unfair. Otherwise, the vet and the team are super kind and I have no complaints on their service and care.

I had never heard of a veterinary ophthalmologist until my dog needed one!  Dr. Nettune and his staff put me at ease by explaining everything that was going on and what their solution was. In no time my pup was in surgery and then on his way home. His eye has healed very well. I am so grateful for Dr Nettune’s expertise!  His staff is kind and friendly. I highly recommend Blink if you ever need eye care for your pet!

Dr.Nettune and his team are absolutely fantastic! I took in my Tajin in June for a corneal ulcer and was able to get surgery in the same day. Dr.Nettune explained what exactly was happening to my pups eye and how the surgery would save it and every step of treatment. Every single one of his staff members are super attentive and super sweet. Their service and care is like no other, they truly care about you and your pets!
We love everyone here, including doctors and staff. They have taken great care of our sweet pup and we look forward to coming here for all her optical needs.

My 3 year French Bulldog punctured his right eye.  We don't know how, but this is the second eye he's torn by bush, shrub or something.     Dr. Nettune got us in quickly and recommended surgery and a graft.  Because my pup had limited vision in his other eye (prior puncture), I was pretty certain he was going to lose his vision and be permanently blind.

The surgery was a success and after a month in  a cone, he's now free and has regained his vision.  The best part?  Dr. Nettune began treating his other eye and we believe he has at least some vision/light sensation (where he had none before).

Dr. Nettune's staff is caring, attentive and treat you and your pet like family.  It is hands down the best medical care center that I've ever taken one of my animals.  I highly, highly recommend him and his team.

Toro (my dog) and I are very, very thankful to everyone.
Dr. Nettune and his staff are amazing. If you’re ever experiencing any eye issues with your pet, don’t go anywhere else.
I met a wonderful doctor on my first visit to this hospital. He was incredibly patient and explained our eye problems and how to improve them. I hope my baby gets better soon! ❤️ Caramel

Our experience at Blink was excellent. The team is incredibly kind and welcoming, and Dr. Nettune immediately strikes confidence in you as a knowledgeable and caring physician. Thank you all for the expedient and high-quality care.

I am so grateful to have found Dr. Nettune and his staff.
Thank you for providing amazing care and a warm and welcoming office for us to visit. :)

Dr. Nettune is so kind and gentle! He's very knowledgeable and was thorough in his examination of our cat, Simon. He explained everything to us and asked us to contact him the same day we see any changes in Simon's eyes. He sent us a written explanation of the results of our visit and sent the information to our vet. Everyone at the Blink vet office was very nice! Also, they worked us in as quickly as they could. I highly recommend Dr. Nettune and his practice.
What a friendly staff and amazing Doctor!  He saved my kitten's eye.  Would highly recommend this place.
A very professional yet warm and truly amazing group performing fantastic procedures that change animals' lives dramatically. cannot say enough good things about this outstanding group.
Excellent staff and Vet. Very friendly and knowledgeable. They went out of their way to accommodate me and my dog. I would highly recommend them! 5 STARS!!!

Dr. Nettune took the time to fully explain the difficult genetic issues my Double Merle Aussie was facing, and her treatment plan and prognosis. Other veterinary ophthalmologists in town just prescribed drops and didn't know or try to explain what was causing her vision loss. He understood the causes for her blindness and offered suggestions to help her adjust to life without vision. He and his staff were all reassuring and thorough and answered all my questions. I look forward to our next visit as I know they care about my Aussie's quality of life.

Dr. Nettune is a magician. My dog, Pico, developed Type 1 diabetes, followed shortly by diabetic cataracts and near complete blindness in a matter of a month. We visited a couple of specialists and chose Dr. Nettune because of his outstanding bedside manner, attention to detail, and transparency. I also liked that Blink is a family- owned business, not a corporate clinic. Dr. Nettune performed lense replacement surgery, and Pico went from being functionally blind to being able to see the day of the surgery and is now (9 months later) indistinguishable from his previous self. If you go this route, be sure you’re paying for an exceptional surgeon and staff, rather than the swanky expensive decor you’ll find at some corporate clinics.

Me and my cat had a great experience with Blink Eye Vet. The doctor was very kind and professional when I got emotional about my cats diagnosis. All of the techs were super nice. My cat is healing wonderfully and is back to his normal self.

Our sweet boy had to have eye removed while we were on vacation.  Horrible experience,  but Blink and staff made overwhelming experience a kind and thoughtful occurrence for my two nieces who handled all the details. We are grateful forlove and care of facility staffers.

I had a great experience with Dr. Nettune and his staff.  Our dog Charlie is diabetic and recently developed cataract.  During our first visit, Dr. Nettune walked us through the surgery process and answered all of our questions thoroughly. We wanted to proceed with surgery as soon as possible so they worked to fit him in within a couple of days.  The result was amazing- Charlie has now fully recovered and we are thrilled that he got his vision back!  Dr. Nettune and his entire team offered exceptional care for Charlie throughout the whole process.  Thank you Blink!

Dr. Nettune and his staff - specifically Jeanette and Kaitlyn are absolutely amazing. I was lucky enough to get a same day appointment and we had such a wonderful experience. Everyone was so sweet to my old man and Dr. Nettune spent a ton of time with me explaining everything, going over all of our options, and coming up with the best game plan for Gunner. We drove over 2.5 hours to see him and will gladly make that drive again. While we still aren’t out of the woods quite yet I am extremely happy that my dog is being taken care of by the best. Thank you for everything!

Dr. Nettune eased all of our concerns and we fully trust him and his team. My dog needed a stye surgically removed and we were referred by Dr. Tunnell at City Vet. The surgery was so quick and easy, it didn’t appear my dog experienced hardly any discomfort, and her healing process has been better than we could ever hope for. The whole team is very communicative and will text any time even on weekends, which is highly appreciated!

Dr. Nettune is a dog whisperer! He is amazing and treated my bulldog with such kindness! Kaitlyn is an excellent tech and it was a great experience! I would recommend Blink to anyone who needs a vet eye specialist!

I'm so glad we came to Blink. Our dachshund Linus developed diabetes and lost his sight within months. These folks are the best! They are caring and a pleasure to be around. Dr. Nettune is fantastic. Linus is once again his bright eye self.

Exceptional Care for Charlotte at Blink Veterinary Eye Specialists!

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles and a sense of reassurance.  I knew Charlotte was in the right hands.  My experience with the entire team at Blink Veterinary Eye Specialists was truly exceptional.

Dr. Chris Nettune is an absolute gem!  He demonstrated incredible expertise, compassion, and patience.  I was a nervous wreck, but he took the time to thoroughly explain Charlotte's eye condition and all the treatment options. He patiently answered every single one of my (many!) questions, making a stressful situation so much easier to bear.

I also want to give a huge shout-out to Gisela, Kaitlyn, Jeannette, and Shyquinca.  Their patience, helpfulness, and understanding were invaluable.  This whole process was incredibly stressful, but they all made it manageable.

Every single person I encountered, from the front desk to the medical team, showed genuine care and professionalism.  But Dr. Nettune truly made a significant impact on Charlotte's life.  He brought light back into her eyes.
Charlotte and I are forever grateful

I highly recommend Blink Veterinary Eye Specialists to anyone seeking the best possible care for their beloved pets.
Dr. Nettune and his entire staff are so professional, thorough and delightful to work with.  I would recommend their services to anyone that has a need for a specialist!

The vet and staff were incredible. My Westie developed an ulcer, and with their guidance and the prescribed medication, we were able to get it under control quickly. She’s feeling much better now and is doing great.

Absolutely phenomenal from start to finish. Our cat Gunter started having significant problems with his eye. We went to 2 other cat ophthalmologists who couldn’t explain to us what was happening (and as a doctor myself, that was a big red flag). From the very first time we met Dr. Nettune it was clear he knows exactly what he’s talking about. He took time to draw out the problem and make sure my husband and I both understood. He laid out all the options and all of the potential risks. He truly had Gunter’s best interests at heart every step of the way. And when it became obvious that Gunter’s eye couldn’t be saved, Dr. Nettune and his staff made the entire process so warm and supportive for Gunter, me; and my husband. They’re excellent at communication and genuinely the best cat ophthalmologist we’ve seen (and overall we’ve seen 4 different ones in Dallas!). I highly recommend him and his team!

What an AMAZING top to bottom experience!!!  We had to take one of our rescue cats to see Dr Nettune at Blink Veterinary Eye Specialist due to problems with his eye.  After visiting 3 other Doctors in the Dallas area, my wife and I finally found Dr Nettune and we have been 100% blown away by his table side demeanor and how he explains the care extremely well.  We finally found a Doctor who genuenly cares about our concerns and the well being of our rescue cat.  We would 100% return to see Dr Nettune  if any of our pets require an eye specialist.
I had to drive from Austin, but Dr Nettune made the trip well worth the drive.

Dr.Nettune has been treating my dog for over 4 years for glaucoma in one eye and trying to prevent it from occurring in the other eye. He has been successful in keeping her good eye from getting glaucoma.
I have thoroughly enjoyed having Dr Nettune as my vet as he is kind, professional, and very caring.  He obviously is very competent in his field. His staff has also been very pleasant to work with and seem to be as caring.
I highly recommend Dr. Nettune and Blink.
Very caring and great surgical skills !

This clinic, Dr. Nettune, and his team are a blessing!
Bailey had an accident earlier this year; after a visit to the ER and multiple visits to her primary vet, we were finally referred to Blink Veterinary.
The referral by it self was very stressful, we were sent to see Dr. Nettune after her surgeon had to stop mid procedure and realizing the problem was deeper than expected. Dr. Nettune saw Bailey less than 2 hours after that.
Maybe it is just me but, when your pet is injured it is easy to dwell on it thinking that it was you as a bad owner who was to blame. So I was already feeling awful.
The ladies at Blink were kind and gentle, I cannot thank them enough for the warmth they showed us. They were very flexible squeezing us in their busy schedule and were patient as I struggled to explain what had happened.
As for Dr. Nettune, few times I have encountered such a professional and kind person. He explained the situation carefully (in language I could understand, no technical jargon) and went over the possible options we had. Something I noticed as he was talking to us was that, he made us feel ok about each and every option we had, he wasn't pushing for the expensive treatment or made it look better compared to the any other option, which made me think that he is aware that not every family has the possibility to go for an expensive treatment. I truly appreciated that.
Fast forward to today... Bailey's eyes are healthy.
Dr Nettune is excellent! He is very knowledgeable and is great at communicating with the client. So glad my vet recommended him for my kiddo.

The best of the best Animal Ophthalmology
CLINIC. Thank you Dr. Christian Nettune And all of your wonderful staff. Your saved my dogs life. Thank you very very much.
Snowcone and apple
Chris and his team here truly are outstanding. Thank you Chris for being kind, caring and a joy to work with!!

Exceptional, caring, professional! Dr. Nettune & staff delivered thorough treatment for our 17 year old Sheltie, and had great bedside manner with her as well. Dr. Nettune patiently and completely explained the condition, the treatment and answered all of our questions. Thank you!!!

Dr. Nettune and his amazing team provided a level of care that is truly on a different level. Our 2 boys Sheldon & Cooper (Bassett Hound brothers) are diabetic and developed cataract's. The team at Blink walked us through the entire surgical and aftercare  process and were available for any questions or concerns throughout this journey. The results have been life changing for Sheldon and Cooper and we are happy to say they are back to being their LOUD and STUBBORN selves. Thank you Blink Team !!
